newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Italy's BPER long, short-term ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Italy's BPER long, short-term ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Wednesday said it has affirmed Banca Popolare dell'Emilia-Romagna's long-term rating at A plus and short-term rating at A1.
"The individual and legal ratings are also unchanged at B and 4 respectively," IBCA said in a statement.
"Banca Popolare dell'Emilia-Romagna (BPER) has consistently reported better performance than average," said IBCA.

"Its strong presence in the wealthy region of Emilia-Romagna has kept the bank's interest margin relatively high, which, together with a slimline structure and healthy asset quality, have resulted in good profitability."
However, IBCA said, over the past couple of years BPER had embarked upon a series of domestic banking acquisitions, not all of which were as strong-performing as the parent.
"BPER will have to work hard on some of these banks to improve their asset quality, and loan loss provisions can be expected to increase moderately over the next couple of years," the agency said.
"BPER's liquidity and capitalisation remain good, with an end-June 1996 EU total capital and tier 1 ratios of 10.90 percent and 9.0 percent respectively," IBCA said.
